author: Michael Larabel
description: An initiative led by CodeWeavers this year has come to fruition for improving OpenGL support with WoW64 for bettering Windows 32-bit application/game support while using 64-bit system libraries...
title: Wine Merges Support For MESA_map_buffer_client_pointer To Improve WoW64 32-bit OpenGL

author: Michael Larabel
description: Merged today for the ongoing Linux 7.4 merge window is the infrastructure for enabling DMA-BUF support in the kernel's I/O path with the wonderful IO_uring framework...
title: Linux 7.4 Introduces DMA-BUF Support To I/O Path With IO_uring

author: Michael Larabel
description: It looks like a next-generation Raspberry Pi Zero is about to surface, the long-awaited Raspberry Pi Zero 3 W. And in an interesting twist in these times amid high PC component costs and supply chain constraints, a Raspberry Pi 4 Model A...
title: Raspberry Pi Zero 3 W & Raspberry Pi 4 Model A Surface In Linux Kernel Patches

author: Michael Larabel
description: A long-standing KDE bug is set to be resolved with next month's KDE Frameworks 6.32 release...
title: KDE Fixes 15 Year Old Bug Over Inaccurate Notifications When Copying Files To USB Drives

author: Michael Larabel
description: Back in September Ikey Doherty of Solus Linux and Serpent OS notoriety as well as being a former Intel Clear Linux developer announced  Barney as his planned showcase for how to "properly" build a modern Linux distribution in 2026+. Today he's provided an update on this Barney distro tooling effort as well as announcing Pavee OS as his planned daily-driver desktop distribution built atop it...
title: Pavee OS: Ikey Doherty's New Daily-Driver Desktop Distro Being Built Atop Barney

author: Michael Larabel
description: Debuting two weeks ago on the 30th anniversary of the KDE project was the Plasma 6.8 desktop with many exciting improvements. Last week it was succeeded by Plasma 6.8.1 with dozens of bug fixes and this week now brings Plasma 6.8.2 with yet more bug fixing...
title: KDE Plasma 6.8.2 Released With Dozens Of Additional Bug Fixes

author: Michael Larabel
description: The many Kernel-based Virtual Machine (KVM) improvements have been merged for Linux 7.4 to deliver a number of new features for different server processors...
title: AMD EPYC Zen 6 PML Support, ARM64 On s390 Merged For Linux 7.4 KVM

author: Michael Larabel
description: An interesting new open-source project born out of university research is Beeper to provide application-layer parsing within the in-kernel eBPF. With an HTTP parser implemented by Beeper in eBPF and providing an in-kernel HTTP cache, the throughput for web servers could be improved by 3x at high rates...
title: Accelerating HTTP Web Servers With In-Kernel eBPF Deliver Up To 4.5x Throughput

author: Michael Larabel
description: Merged back in Linux 7.1 was the new NTFS kernel driver implementation for better supporting Microsoft's NTFS file-system on Linux. Since then new features and improvements have continued to land for this NTFS driver with some more notable additions also coming in Linux 7.4...
title: Linux's Modern NTFS Driver Now Supports Alternate Data Streams (ADS)

author: Michael Larabel
description: With the Linux 7.4 kernel there are more MSI and ASUS motherboards with sensor monitoring support along with a variety of other additions to help broaden the selection of supported systems for hardware sensor monitoring under Linux. It's another busy cycle for the HWMON subsystem...
title: Linux 7.4 Expands Sensor Monitoring For More ASUS & MSI Motherboards, New Minisforum Driver

author: Michael Larabel
description: Firefox 159 is out today as the latest bi-weekly feature release for Mozilla's web browser...
title: Firefox 159 Released With AMD  Linux Graphics Fix For Excessive Memory Use
